localSource.implementationCommitSubject: feat(search): complete search-results local R3a readiness

routeFamily.exclusionPolicy: search-home and book-search remain entry/history/suggestion surfaces and receive no search-results-action identity. Other listed search surfaces belong to separate page families. This packet does not claim the complete global search product.
routeFamily.dispatchPolicy: All four primary routes resolve through D2-A STATE_VARIANT_MAP to bookSearchV2 before the render-runtime switch.
routeFamily.fallbackPolicy: All four render-runtime switch fallbacks fail loudly instead of invoking bookSearchScreen or searchStateScreen.

r2aInstrumentation.identityPolicy: The stable query domain, result book IDs and named search actions are the only identity inputs. Labels, selectors, DOM order, ordinal n0-style keys and screenshots are prohibited.
r2aInstrumentation.runtimeEvidence: The deterministic interaction inventory rendered the four primary routes and found 19/19 semantic controls carrying all five canonical identity attributes.
r2aInstrumentation.secondaryIsolationEvidence: Generated registry differences are limited to search-results/search-loading/search-empty/search-error. search-home and book-search registry entries are byte-unchanged from the baseline.

guards: search and retry reject a second start while pending.status is loading
completion requires the current requestId and requestEpoch
close increments requestEpoch and marks the request cancelled so later completion resolves stale
a repeated close is idempotently reported as closed
result selection accepts only long-night, mystery-lord or three-body
empty and failure outcomes preserve query ownership and do not transfer to search-home
runtimeWiring: submit and reset dispatch through the bookSearch owner
data-search-close cancels the owner request before navigation back
data-search-retry uses executeRetry and replaces loading with results/error
stable result rows dispatch SELECT_RESULT before opening Book Detail

ariaAndFocus.resultRows: Three result rows are role=button, tabindex=0, explicitly labelled and keyed by stable book ID.
ariaAndFocus.queryInputs: Primary and keyboard inputs have explicit accessible names and share the stable query ID.
ariaAndFocus.loading: role=status, aria-live=polite and aria-busy=true; cancel remains enabled.
ariaAndFocus.empty: role=status and aria-live=polite with real retry and Discover actions.
ariaAndFocus.error: role=alert and aria-live=assertive with retry and Source Management recovery.
ariaAndFocus.focusReturn: Submit, result rows, keyboard close, reset/retry and outbound recovery launchers carry exact data-restore-focus control keys.
ariaAndFocus.back: Every primary state page back button carries mapped route-local identity.

figmaReadOnlyBaseline.structuralPolicy: The serial writer must identify the real Search Results component set and downstream instances from a fresh revision, repair canonical components first, and preserve existing reactions. Unknown node IDs are intentionally not guessed.

figmaDecisionsRequired: Read a fresh official Figma revision and resolve the real Search Results component set, Phone master, Tablet master and downstream instances before writing.
Update shared query field, result row, add-to-bookshelf action and loading/empty/error components before page masters.
Keep result book identity stable and right-align trailing source/status/actions.
Represent loading, empty and error through the same canonical page family and preserve exact focus-return intent.
Do not pull search-home, book-search or any other search surface into this F2 transaction.
Use only Phone and Tablet; Landscape inherits Tablet and Compact/Fold structures are prohibited.
Preserve reactions. Figma may not change UiEvent, state owner, async guards, route ownership or Book Detail flow.
Detached frames and screenshot replacements are prohibited.
